expectations.text: no_metadata_extraction: Agent does NOT try to extract metadata or rename — it's a URL, not a file
expectations.evidence: Baseline Step 1 attempts WebFetch to extract metadata from the URL — unnecessary for a URL save.

expectations.text: daily_note_markdown_link: Daily note uses markdown link format [Title](URL), not wiki-link
expectations.evidence: Baseline uses '- [ ] [SEC Enforcement Update](url)' format — correct markdown link.

expectations.text: readwise_save: Agent saves URL to Readwise Reader with appropriate tag
expectations.evidence: Baseline cannot find Readwise save tool, falls back to raw curl API call without knowing auth token. Would likely fail.

expectations.text: daily_note_under_reading: Daily note entry is inserted under # Reading heading
expectations.evidence: Baseline guesses vault path and note structure — 'Don't know vault path, note structure, or template.'
